activity.notes: After Charles I was executed in 1649, the Scots proclaimed Charles II king. He was crowned at Scone on 1 January 1651 and lost effective Scottish royal power after the defeat at Worcester in September 1651. ATLAS records this Scottish kingship separately from the later 1660 Restoration rule.

sources.title: Charles II (r. 1660-1685) — The Royal Family
sources.citation_text: The Royal Family records that the Scots proclaimed Charles II king in 1649, crowned him at Scone on 1 January 1651, and that his forces were defeated at Worcester in September 1651.
